title: Elon Musk Announces Special Committee to Explore SpaceX-Tesla Merger
summary: Elon Musk has announced the formation of a special committee to explore a management integration of SpaceX and Tesla.

title: SpaceX Turns First Profit Since IPO, AI-Driven Equipment Rental Revenue Surges 9-Fold
summary: SpaceX achieved its first profit since going public, with AI-related equipment rental business significantly boosting revenue.

title: Nikkei Average Rebounds Sharply, Temporarily Rising Over 1,000 Yen on Strong SpaceX Earnings
summary: The Nikkei Average rebounded, temporarily recovering to the 65,100 level, buoyed by strong SpaceX earnings and gains in U.S. stocks.

title: First-Half Trade Deficit Hits 2.8184 Trillion Yen, Nearly Double Year-Earlier Level for 11th Straight Half-Year Deficit
summary: Imports hit a record high of 66 trillion yen due to soaring crude oil prices, resulting in an 11th consecutive half-year trade deficit.

title: Junior High Student Stabbed with Ice Pick in Sapporo, in Critical Condition; 14-Year-Old Boy Arrested for Attempted Murder
summary: A junior high school student was stabbed in the chest on his way to school in Sapporo and left unconscious in critical condition; a 14-year-old classmate was arrested.

title: Two Post Office Employees Prevent Elderly Fraud Victim After Noticing Suspicious ATM Withdrawal Inquiry, Receive Letter of Appreciation
summary: Quick-thinking post office staff noticed unnatural behavior and prevented an elderly person from falling victim to a special fraud scheme.

title: Former Alumni Association President of Minoo Jiyu Gakuen Sued for Alleged Embezzlement of 87 Million Yen
summary: The former alumni association president of a private school in Osaka has been criminally sued on suspicion of embezzling approximately 87 million yen in membership fees.

title: Japan Wins Back-to-Back Men's Team Titles at World Gymnastics Championships, Secures Paris Olympics Berth
summary: The Japanese men's team achieved a second consecutive victory at the World Championships, securing a spot at the 2024 Paris Olympics.

title: Foreign Ministry Director-General Visits Russia, Demands Early Consular Access After Detention of Hokkaido Shimbun Reporter
summary: A Foreign Ministry director-general held talks in Russia demanding the immediate release and consular access for a detained Hokkaido Shimbun reporter.

title: Investigation Committee Finds 9 Former Nidec Officers Liable for 27.6 Billion Yen in Damages Over Accounting Fraud
summary: An independent investigation committee recognized liability for damages of approximately 27.6 billion yen against nine former officers, one of the largest such amounts ever, over accounting irregularities.

title: Family of Gentle Brother Killed in Limited Express Derailment Criticizes JR Tokai for 'Treating Life Lightly'
summary: The family of a man killed in a limited express train derailment strongly condemned JR Tokai's response, accusing them of 'treating life lightly.'

title: Personal Data of Over 23,000 People Leaked in Government Energy-Saving Housing Project, Possibly via Contractors
summary: Applicant personal data of approximately 23,000 cases may have been leaked externally through registered contractors in a government subsidy program.

title: Prefectural Police Personnel Data Leaks in Kanagawa, Fukuoka, Kagoshima; Tochigi Leak Affects All Staff
summary: Incidents of personal data leaks involving prefectural police staff occurred in multiple prefectures, with the Tochigi leak affecting all personnel.

title: Constitutional Democratic Party Shifts from Zero Consumption Tax, Proposes 40,000 Yen Annual Handout Per Person in New Reform Plan
summary: The Constitutional Democratic Party retracted its consumption tax abolition pledge and unveiled a new economic package centered on a 40,000 yen annual payout per person for low-income earners.

title: Release of Americans Detained in Russia Imminent? U.S. Media Reports Trump Transition Team Negotiating Behind Scenes
summary: U.S. media reported that the incoming Trump administration is engaged in behind-the-scenes negotiations for the release of Americans detained in Russia.

title: U.S. Business Groups Sue Trump Administration to Block Proposed Tariffs on Canada
summary: U.S. business groups filed a lawsuit challenging the legality of tariffs on Canada proposed by President-elect Trump.

title: Government to Automate Operations with AI Agents, Streamlining Document Search and Drafting
summary: The government has decided to introduce AI agents to automate routine tasks for civil servants, such as document searching and drafting.
